rumor.content: Exact plain UTF-8 text, never a JSON commerce record
rumor.recipient_set: Sorted unique author and peer; one exact rumor for every per-recipient seal, including a deduplicated self-conversation
rumor.authorization: Codec descriptors verify no source, parent, history, grant, consent, route or participant authority

canonical.preimage: NIP-01 [0,pubkey,created_at,kind,tags,content], exact tag order and Unicode, lowercase control escapes, no Unicode normalization
canonical.legacy: Event wire-v1 delegates canonical serialization while retaining its full accepted u64 timestamp/u32 kind range and public parse/error behavior
canonical.private_buffers: Bound complete serialization before copying; clear owned rumor and temporary preimage text; no payload-bearing automatic diagnostics
canonical.unsigned_json: Exact id/pubkey/created_at/kind/tags/content with no signature; complete unsigned length equals canonical preimage length plus 116 bytes
canonical.signed_json_length: The supported exact complete signed object length equals canonical preimage length plus 253 bytes

seal.timestamp: Explicit positive time no later than rumor time and at most 172800 seconds earlier; runtime supplies checked randomized input
seal.ciphertext: Canonical base64 shape, version-2 prefix, exact predicted padded payload size; structural checks do not authenticate a MAC
seal.signing: Convert validated known-kind fields through the existing exact-intent signer; no command or durable-admission authority is created

nested_budget.profile: Size calculations cover the standard two-byte NIP-44 v2 length prefix for lengths 1 through 65535; no extended-prefix support is claimed.
nested_budget.provider_caps: A size calculation does not advertise encryption capability for every counted input. Both selected chat layers must fit the concrete provider's 65536-byte text/ciphertext boundary and the complete signed-event bounds.
nested_budget.measurement: Before business seal signing, count complete rumor, padded/base64 rumor ciphertext, worst supported-timestamp signed seal, padded/base64 outer ciphertext and complete signed 1059 envelope
nested_budget.qualification: Independent ECMAScript JSON/SHA-256/base64 vectors plus actual Rust encryption/signature/decryption conversion; structural vectors deliberately carry no valid MAC

remaining: Complete owned native execution route/capability approval and ordinary client job orchestration, install/outbox, exact per-recipient wrapping/delivery, full receipts, browser/bindings and final acceptance

recipient_dm_routes.empty_advertisement: Explicit unavailable DM information; no fallback
recipient_dm_routes.data_constructor_authority: No signature, source identity, configured/available transport, grant or consent proof; execution revalidates before dispatch

native_signing_plan.recipient_set: Exactly sorted unique author and peer; no partial set
native_signing_plan.retained: Original command and message commitments, exact per-recipient seal author/kind/time/tags/content/event ID/purpose, original signed route-source bytes, selected targets and explicit replay declaration
native_signing_plan.retained_memory: Canonical buffer bounded before allocation; decoded recipient collections use boxed slices, not caller spare vector capacity
native_signing_plan.predecessors: Preserve and refuse; no inferred timestamps or automatic namespace rewrite
native_signing_plan.queue: 32 slots plus conservative queued and in-flight reservations under 4194304 bytes
native_signing_plan.transaction: Current protected grant, original preparation, all indexed facts and fixed first-issue window rechecked under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; crypto work before transaction
native_signing_plan.completion: Confirmed commit, known rollback and original anchored unknown are distinct; accepted owner work survives observer loss
native_signing_plan.remaining: Execution route/capability approval, owned ordinary execution, T2/D, complete receipts, supported consumer adoption, browser/binding runtime and final acceptance

native_issuance.attempt_identity: Full 256-bit Domain SigningAttemptId; immutable original command, plan, recipient, exact v1 intent, first-issue window and transaction provenance
native_issuance.intent_data_owner: radroots_protocol::intent; Signing reexports preserve the exact existing v1 byte layout
native_issuance.fresh_claim: Current protected grant, complete original facts and deadline rechecked under BEGIN IMMEDIATE before dispatch; no signer invocation inside SQLite
native_issuance.retained_or_unknown_claim: Potential issuance; never infer safe reissue
native_issuance.obtained_capture: Append only independently verified original bytes matching the actual protected claim; original credential and scope without fresh deadline, revocation or observation-clock admission
native_issuance.caller_ownership: Borrowed original retained by caller through error, lost observer or unknown completion
native_issuance.observation: First original optional time is immutable; missing time remains null
native_issuance.remaining: Ordinary client-owned orchestration and full operation receipts, route/provider approval, installation/outbox/delivery, target graph retirement and all consumer/final gates

native_operation_snapshot.query: OperationJournal::operation_snapshot on the existing native owner
native_operation_snapshot.transaction: Authenticate complete original T0/T1/S and protected T2 records outside transaction; recheck current grant, all retained and absent facts and complete bounded graph counts under BEGIN IMMEDIATE; confirmed rollback before reporting
native_operation_snapshot.extra_or_orphan_rows: Recovery required; never silently omitted from a complete report
native_operation_snapshot.memory: One complete owned plan and at most two sorted unique boxed recipient reports; no private raw bytes or automatic payload serialization in receipt diagnostics
native_operation_snapshot.progress_digest: SHA-256 with radroots.operation.snapshot.v2 NUL separator; original v1 fact dimensions plus optional installation transaction/time/basis capture and each recipient publication-work transaction/time; excludes query time and diagnostic correlation
native_operation_snapshot.first_issue_expiry: Remaining unrequested work is blocked; obtained and unknown classifications are preserved. Expiry proves no nonissuance.
native_operation_snapshot.scope: Original actor/workspace/authority/route, command/transactions/window, authority evidence checkpoint, logical-message and structured-record namespaces, protected artifact references and nullable original observations
native_operation_snapshot.construction_authority: Pure values do not authenticate a principal, qualify a custom adapter, permit dispatch or prove installation/delivery
native_operation_snapshot.remaining: Exact outer wrapping/delivery, library-owned ordinary inbox jobs, complete browser/binding/consumer closure and final acceptance
native_operation_snapshot.count_bounds: Whole-operation extra-recipient count checks stop at excess sentinels 3 claims, 3 obtained manifests and 9 parts; absent-operation checks use EXISTS. Existing protected per-recipient part bounds and authentication remain mandatory. T2 sentinels stop at 2 messages and 3 publication-work rows.

native_installation.transaction_owner: Existing bounded native workspace connection worker; no second engine
native_installation.business_view: radroots_domain::ChatMessage; original captured text/relations and original logical message time, independently owned and diagnostically redacted
native_installation.body_retention: Original authenticated T0 command; fixed protected T2 records reference it and the exact complete T1 plan without duplicate private text
native_installation.atomic_effect: One logical chat_messages installation plus eligible actual-recipient chat_publication_work in one IMMEDIATE transaction; complete current grant and all retained/absent T0/T1/S/T2 facts compared before writes
native_installation.partial_and_late: Any actual matching obtained recipient artifact may establish the original installation. Later capture adds only its missing publication work; original installation transaction/time and earlier links stay unchanged.
native_installation.window: Original first-issue window constrains new signatures, not installation of matching already obtained evidence. Current access still gates T2.
native_installation.outcomes: Confirmed commit, known rollback and original anchored unknown; unknown latches until safe reopen. Claims/evidence are never released by T2 failures or observer loss.
native_installation.replay: Compare original retained graph before fresh work; no replacement installation, new entropy/protection or signature on exact replay
native_installation.live_queue: Existing 32 slots and 4194304 accepted/in-flight input bytes; 16384-byte installation input reservation
native_installation.cutover: Preserve and refuse all predecessor namespaces, including actual schema5 claims/evidence; no automatic upgrade or state deletion
native_installation.reporting: Owned message only with scoped actual installation report; independent original installation and recipient work transactions; delivery pending and zero inferred relay observations
native_installation.qualification: Separate exact-source executed evidence; declarations and data constructors are not qualification
native_installation.remaining: Exact outer-envelope retention and per-target D observations, ordinary library-owned inbox jobs, browser/bindings, supported consumer adoption and all final gates

outer_wrapping.source: Exact seven-field, depth-bounded, ID and BIP-340 verified original kind13 event; empty tags and supported NIP44v2 payload shape; actual operation/recipient/capture linkage remains the composing journal responsibility
outer_wrapping.representation: Encrypt original UTF8 bytes, including whitespace, not a canonical replacement; size complete nested output before requesting entropy
outer_wrapping.entropy: Explicit qualified NonceSource for independent temporary key, unbiased randomized past timestamp, NIP44 nonce and BIP340 auxiliary randomness; no ambient clock or participant signer call. Upstream secp256k1 context blinding retains its own initialization contract; no ambient artifact-entropy fallback.
outer_wrapping.qualification: Separate exact-source executed evidence; this declaration does not qualify durable capture, transport, a custom entropy source or a host runtime
outer_wrapping.temporary_material: Opaque noncloneable pending outer holds zeroizing original 32-byte key and permits a scoped verification borrow. Known author and recipient keys are refused. The pinned upstream erases Keys/SecretKey on Drop using non_secure_erase; no total memory-erasure guarantee is claimed for upstream intermediate values.
outer_wrapping.authority: Construction authenticates a seal and creates an outer representation; it proves no grant, route, operation linkage, durable capture, scheduling lease or delivery
outer_wrapping.remaining: Protected native exact-envelope and target-intent retention before transport, bound observations, ordinary owned inbox jobs, browser/binding runtime and final acceptance
